items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I was still fighting with TB.

ctx.x: It was the same thing. I was still fighting with TB. I didn't have to go around, I didn't have to do anything but produce. It was my own time.
The article in Metronome that Simon wrote around that time, the tone of it was you hadn't been too happy with the conditions you had to work in previously.
